name: squibl
description: Squibl monorepo — Next.js frontend + Express/Node.js backend

scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.clean: rimraf frontend/.next backend/dist node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules
